claims: Bryan Adams has announced a "Roll With The Punches" world tour for 2026.
The "Roll With The Punches" world tour includes a U.S. summer arena leg featuring special guests Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo.
The "Roll With The Punches" tour supports Bryan Adams's 2025 album Roll With The Punches.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour runs from late July 2026 through mid-August 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in St. Louis on July 24, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in Wichita on July 25, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in Thackerville on July 26, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in Austin on July 28, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in Houston on July 29, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in New Orleans on July 31, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour has a stop in Orlando on August 5, 2026.
The 2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" tour concludes in Milwaukee on August 16, 2026.
Bryan Adams has a Las Vegas residency of "Bare Bones" acoustic shows at Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas in early June 2026.
Bryan Adams's Canada tour commences late August 2026 in Quebec with guest artist Lights.
Bryan Adams has scheduled international tour dates in South Africa, Europe, and Japan in 2026.
